column1: # The environment matrix (M7-8, M7c-2): one row per line, tab-separated.
#   name    the row; results go to tests/results/envmatrix/<tag>/<name>/
#   kind    dynamic: SET GLOBAL on a long-lived pair of MX_IMAGE, restored after the row
#           init:    a fresh pair of MX_IMAGE with an extra cnf (settable only at initialization)
#           version: a fresh, unmutated pair of another image
#   setup   dynamic: the SQL, run on both servers ("-" for none); init: the cnf, relative to
#   expect  pass, or refuse:CODE[|CODE...] (tests/envmatrix/judge): every failing test must
#           cite one of the codes, the M7-8 rule that a run is exact or refused by name

column3: SET GLOBAL character_set_server = latin1; SET GLOBAL collation_server = latin1_swedish_ci
SET GLOBAL wait_timeout = 10; SET GLOBAL interactive_timeout = 10
